title: Skipped civil date is still a valid label
rationale: Date-only labels need not correspond to an instant in a display zone. Apia skipped this civil date but the Gregorian label remains valid.

oracle.method: Literal expected reviewed with Gregorian rules, manual UTC = local − offset, and independent CPython zoneinfo/TZif cross-check; no Temporal imports.
oracle.calculation: Gregorian 2011-12-30 is valid; no timezone mapping is part of date-only storage.
